title: Grain Marketing Contracts: Forward Position Ceilings and Production History Windows
content:
Two catalogue figures govern how much of a member's production may stand sold forward under Grain Marketing Contracts: the share of the production history average a programme allows to stand sold, and the number of completed crop years averaged to form that history.

| Programme | Share of production history allowed to stand sold forward (percent) | Completed crop years averaged (count) |
|---|---|---|
| Spot Cash Delivery Ticket | 100.0 | 3 |
| Forward Cash Sale Contract | 85.0 | 3 |
| Basis Fixed Contract | 75.0 | 3 |
| Hedge-to-Arrive Contract | 70.0 | 3 |
| Delayed Price Agreement | 100.0 | 3 |
| Minimum Price Contract | 60.0 | 4 |
| Managed Accumulator Program | 50.0 | 5 |

Both figures are taken from the programme of the contract being written, never from the programmes the member already holds. The share falls as the programme takes more market risk on the member's behalf: the Managed Accumulator Program allows only half the history to stand sold and averages five completed crop years, while the Spot Cash Delivery Ticket and the Delayed Price Agreement allow the whole of it over three years.
